summary: DestProfilePrfRequirements manages prerequisite requirements for a destination profile, separating requirements by type (Standard, Document, Link), discipline, and section. The system allows users to add, edit, or delete requirements, filter by discipline, and group requirements by section. Users can specify whether requirements apply to all disciplines or only selected sub-disciplines, with an interactive UI for selection and validation. Uploaded documents are handled securely and stored per requirement.
purpose: To provide a user interface and backend logic for managing prerequisite requirements related to a destination profile in a system, supporting workflows for adding, editing, deleting, and grouping requirements, filtering by discipline, and associating requirements with documents or links.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Requirement
steps: User enters/selects requirement type, description, website, document name, section
User specifies whether applies to all disciplines; if not, selects included/excluded sub-disciplines
If uploading a document, file is processed, stored, and linked
Requirement is saved or updated in GenericRequirements
UI refresh/grid reloads and cache is updated

workflows.name: Delete Requirement
steps: Session cache is updated and page redirects

workflows.name: Filter Requirements
steps: User selects discipline or filter option
System filters requirements accordingly and updates grid

workflows.name: Group Requirements by Section
steps: Requirements grouped in UI by section
Section headers are dynamically inserted in grid

workflows.name: Upload Document
steps: System validates and saves file in new GUID-named folder under DestDocs
File URL and metadata linked to requirement

business_rules: If AllowAllSubDisciplines is selected or no included disciplines, requirement applies to all disciplines.
Requirement types hidden by codes (HideDocType, HideUrlType) are removed from dropdowns.
Section grouping supports empty or named sections.
Requirement description must be provided for non-document/link types.
Uploaded files must be non-empty and are stored in unique folders.
validations: Document file presence and type upon upload
calculations: TextList(ListBox lb) returns comma-separated SubDiscipline names
conditions: UseSubDisciplines determines visibility of discipline selection UI
system_behavior: Dynamic UI updates for prerequisite type changes
Visibility toggled for discipline-related fields based on session and settings
dependencies: Disciplines for listing and associating sub-disciplines
exceptions: HandleUploadedFile returns false if file upload fails or is empty
DataSource is cancelled if UserSession is null
Add/Edit operation notes warning if no included disciplines
